title: A documented non-return decision can follow job search and alternative employment without proving durable distrust or recovery
source_unit: Primary Fair Work Commission decision [2023] FWC 2485 and order PR766604

observations.period: June 28–September 4, 2023; dismissal, job search, alternative employment, non-return, and compensation order

denominator.unit: publicly identified adjudicated worker case; no population denominator

alternative_employment_start.unit: new full-time employment; pay reported at least equivalent

compensation_order.unit: Australian dollars, ordered by electronic transfer within 21 days

non_return_reason.value: worker stated she did not wish to return because of the customer-allocation mechanism

payment_receipt_and_later_recovery.unit: missing transfer confirmation, adequacy, job duration, household, trust, recurrence, and exit evidence

observations.method: Structured extraction from the primary Fair Work Commission decision and linked order; job-search count, unemployment interval, alternative employment, non-return reason, assessed loss, and remedy order are kept separate from payment and durable outcomes.
observations.uncertainty: One case cannot estimate job-search, non-return, compensation, payment, or recovery rates. The public decision does not enumerate the full offer set, search cost, job duration, household effects, later trust, recurrence, collective action, or exit.
observations.subgroup: One part-time sales/beauty consultant dismissed after disputed performance warnings and a customer-allocation or sales-target mechanism.
observations.counterinterpretation: An explicit non-return statement may reflect a bounded workplace mechanism and constrained choice rather than measured institutional distrust or broad labor-market exit; an order does not prove receipt or adequacy.

related_sources.claim: Official order specifying the A$4,312 electronic-transfer remedy and deadline.
Official Fair Work Commission decision and order search route.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the committed project ledger containing the bounded decision and order extraction.
reproduction_audit.access_boundary: The official route reports job search, new employment, non-return reasoning, and an order but no later payment confirmation, job duration, household recovery, trust, recurrence, collective action, switching, or exit.

boundary: This record adds one primary case with observed job-search effort, alternative employment, an explicit non-return decision tied to a workplace mechanism, and an ordered compensation remedy. It does not establish payment receipt, full trust measurement, household recovery, recurrence, collective action, switching, or exit.
